programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: Have a look at the technologies from the past. You will be surprised to find out in what extent ancient knowledge influences modern technology. The truth about the past is much more complicated and fascinating than we imagine. This eye-opening series is filmed on location in Italy, Greece, Egypt, Holland, and England, and other locations of the world where historical events actually happened, and with the help of computer animation ancient machines and mechanisms are reconstructed. As well the series uses contributions from archaeologists and other experts, footage of historical sites and artifacts and dramatized reconstructions.

programme.title: Battles BC
programme.desc: Step back in time and revisit some of the most brutal battles that took place before Christ. Recreated with stunning technology, we reveal these violent conflicts like never before, examining the soldiers, strategies and weapons deployed by the powerful legions. From Hannibal's clashes with Rome to Alexander the Great's pursuits throughout India, these conflicts have had a resounding impact on our history and with these reconstructions you will see the ferocious aspects of war in antiquity.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: This unique documentary series explores what the planet would look like if all human life diappeared. With comment and opinion coming from scientists, engineers and other experts, this show speculates on how a lack of human intervention would impact on the environment and the other animal species. The show does not provide any explanation as to why humans have vanished from the face of the Earth but does surmise that human infrastructure is still present along with pets and domesticated livestock. Each episode explores what would happen to specific structures such as skyscrapers, bridges and dams or details the impact on human remains, artefacts and other objects. Some real-life abandoned locations are discussed and the show also uses CGI dramatisations to depict how the situation would look after one day, one week, one year, 10 years, 15 years, 25 years, 50 years, 100 years, 200 years, etc.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: An FBI cold case that has laid dormant for 70 years leads a group of world-renown investigators on the ultimate manhunt to finally answer the question: Did Adolf Hitler survive World War II? In early 2014 the FBI declassified hundreds of confidential documents showing that Hitler may have not committed suicide but rather escaped to South America after the fall of Germany. A memo from J. Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." Armed with the most cutting edge technology and these newly released FBI files the team will approach this case like a modern death claims investigation. Whether they are investigating a mysterious Nazi lair deep in the Argentinian jungle or diving for evidence of a missing U-Boat that could of shuttled Hitler to South America our team will focus on the tried and tested tenants for solving a fraudulent death case: follow the money where was the subject last seen, eyewitness reports, make contact with known associates and forensics.With declassified worldwide intelligence providing a wealth of new clues and modern technology never before available we reopen this world famous cold case in hopes of solving the mystery surrounding the demise of one of the biggest criminals of all time.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Documentary series that brings back to life lost cities, structures, cultures, and civilisations, transporting viewers back in time and revealing the truth behind some of history's most iconic eras. Using a combination of cutting-edge technology and archaeological research, the team detail what life was like for these places during their peak of their powers, and use visual overlays to compare past and present landscapes. From the Knights Templar to the lost city of Atlantis, ancient Egypt to Hitler's planned supercity, and ancient Athens to America's wild west, each episodes dives into these extraordinary remnants of human history.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: Have a look at the technologies from the past. You will be surprised to find out in what extent ancient knowledge influences modern technology. The truth about the past is much more complicated and fascinating than we imagine. This eye-opening series is filmed on location in Italy, Greece, Egypt, Holland, and England, and other locations of the world where historical events actually happened, and with the help of computer animation ancient machines and mechanisms are reconstructed. As well the series uses contributions from archaeologists and other experts, footage of historical sites and artifacts and dramatized reconstructions.

programme.title: Battles BC
programme.desc: Step back in time and revisit some of the most brutal battles that took place before Christ. Recreated with stunning technology, we reveal these violent conflicts like never before, examining the soldiers, strategies and weapons deployed by the powerful legions. From Hannibal's clashes with Rome to Alexander the Great's pursuits throughout India, these conflicts have had a resounding impact on our history and with these reconstructions you will see the ferocious aspects of war in antiquity.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: This unique documentary series explores what the planet would look like if all human life diappeared. With comment and opinion coming from scientists, engineers and other experts, this show speculates on how a lack of human intervention would impact on the environment and the other animal species. The show does not provide any explanation as to why humans have vanished from the face of the Earth but does surmise that human infrastructure is still present along with pets and domesticated livestock. Each episode explores what would happen to specific structures such as skyscrapers, bridges and dams or details the impact on human remains, artefacts and other objects. Some real-life abandoned locations are discussed and the show also uses CGI dramatisations to depict how the situation would look after one day, one week, one year, 10 years, 15 years, 25 years, 50 years, 100 years, 200 years, etc.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: An FBI cold case that has laid dormant for 70 years leads a group of world-renown investigators on the ultimate manhunt to finally answer the question: Did Adolf Hitler survive World War II? In early 2014 the FBI declassified hundreds of confidential documents showing that Hitler may have not committed suicide but rather escaped to South America after the fall of Germany. A memo from J. Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." programme.desc: In an era long passed, mighty empires were forged from nothing and rose to the heights of power. programme.title: Mankind Decoded
programme.desc: Using dramatic reconstructions, this fascinating documentary series explores the evolution and advancement of the human race, dissecting the key events and changes that have affected and altered various civilisations. With expert historians offering explanations to these changes, the series reveals how powerful forces of nature compelled humans to adapt, the birth of war, the discovery of fire and metals, and the building of giant structures, among many others.

programme.desc: Утренняя новостная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека

programme.title: Подмена
programme.desc: Оля Козырева много лет прожила счастливо. У нее прекрасный любящий муж - бизнесмен Дмитрий и большой дом. Она никогда не задумывалась ни о сбережениях, ни о карьере, и даже не представляла, что с ней может произойти что-то плохое. Но вот неожиданно муж предъявляет Ольге доказательства ее измены. Дмитрий сразу же подает на развод, его не останавливает даже то, что жена ждет от него ребенка. Оля оказывается выброшенной на улицу без средств к существованию. Благодаря помощи давнего друга Толи, Ольга проводит собственное расследование и находит агентство, которое по заказу богатых клиентов \"решает\" их семейные проблемы. Она понимает, что стала жертвой хитроумной аферы, которую оплатил ее муж, чтобы расторгнуть брак. Оказалось, что у него давно роман на стороне...

programme.title: Хоккей. Чемпионат мира
programme.desc: Чемпионат мира по хоккею с шайбой пройдёт с 15 по 31 мая 2026 года в Швейцарии. 16 команд начнут свой путь к заветному титулу Чемпиона мира, разделившись на 2 группы. Игры Группы А (действующий чемпион мира - США, Швейцария, Финляндия, Германия, Латвия, Австрия, Венгрия и Великобритания) состоятся в Цюрихе. Команды группы В (Канада, Швеция, Чехия, Дания, Словакия, Норвегия, Словения и Италия) поборются за выход в четвертьфиналы во Фрибуре. Групповой этап Чемпионата мира пройдет с 15 по 26 мая. Четвертьфиналы состоятся 28 мая, полуфиналы - 30 мая. Медали Чемпионата мира по хоккею с шайбой 2026 будут разыграны в воскресенье 31 мая.

programme.title: Камчатка. Необыкновенные истории на краю земли
programme.desc: Невероятный рассказ об энтузиастах, усилиями которых сноубординг на Камчатке стал культовым и объединил тысячи молодых людей, дав им путевку в жизнь. Спортсмены-самоучки, выросшие среди вулканов, долгие годы считались сильнейшими в России. Именно они сняли первый отечественный фильм о сноубординге. Благодаря первооткрывателям сноубординга на Камчатке о местных спотах и спортсменах заговорил весь мир.

programme.title: Голое влечение
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Уловки разума
programme.desc: Следователь по особо важным делам Кира Карелина, чье невероятное чутье помогло разгадать множество преступлений, начинает ощущать на себе давление всевозможных версий и гипотез. Маньяк? Серийный убийца? Или что-то еще, более темное и загадочное? В то время как Кира погружается в пучину запутанных улик и непонятных свидетельских показаний, в городе появляется некий Константин Холмогоров, психотерапевт из Москвы, известный своими необычными методами и странными способностями. Его подход к проблемам уникален: он использует регрессивный гипноз, чтобы проникнуть в самые глубины человеческого разума и извлечь там скрытую правду.

programme.title: CNN Newsroom
programme.desc: CNN Newroom provides the most up to date news as it breaks and is the longest running show on the channel, airing twice a day Monday to Friday and throughout the day over the weekends. CNN has developed a lot since its founding in 1980 by American media proprietor Ted Turner as a 24 hour cable news channel. As an organisation, CNN have won multiple awards, including a network-record six news & documentary Emmy Awards in 2018.

programme.title: K-Everything

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin try to get a game back from Tobias but Darwin starts to feel like a sidekick to Gumball and refuses to follow his orders. / Richard overhears Gumball and Darwin making fun of him which hurts his feelings and he has to regain his reputation as a hero. / Gumball tries to look good in the school photo. / Gumball and Darwin get caught in the middle of a trash can war between Richard and Mr. Robinson. / Gumball and Darwin cheat on their maths test get detention and have to escape. / Nicole gets upset with the family at the supermarket when her kids want chocolate but she says no. / The Wattersons must survive a bizarre game of Dodj or Daar through to the end. / Darwin has promised to play video games with Gumball but his promise with Banana Joe interferes.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Lamput takes refuge in a spooky castle on the hill. The Docs, hot on Lamput's heels, find an unattended broomstick, and, typically, their first instinct is to use it to try to squish their orange quarry. But they quickly discover the broomstick has other, way cooler, uses. Before long the Docs are engaged in some high-speed, unlicenced magical broomstick-riding. Luckily for Lamput, the castle's owner steps in. She's green and witchy, and pretty annoyed about being disturbed from her moonbaking. When the docs break her magical broom, she flies into full witch-mode. Everyone gets transformed into frogs. Which, for Lamput, is a normal day at the office.

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP as they explore the wilderness of the creek together. Elder Con comes to the Creek and the Stump Kids are excited - Craig befriends a fellow fan but ends up in a trivia battle with her over a cup, Kelsey sets up a booth and tries to sell her book but has trouble getting any customers, and JP tries to get into a screening room but encounters obstacles - when he finally enters, he discovers something unusual...

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP as they explore the wilderness of the creek together. When JP accidentally destroys a jersey of his, his father sends him a new one from Canada that is blue instead of orange - a couple of hockey kids take to his new look and recruit him into their group, but when he learns that the recruitment is permanent, Craig, Kelsey and Bobby must quickly learn to play on the ice in order to free JP from his obligation.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP as they explore the wilderness of the creek together. With winter over and spring beginning, Kelsey befriends a girl named Sun Chun who owns a hamster named Cookie and runs a giant hamster tunnel all over the Creek - when Craig and JP discover that Cookie has been killed by a cat, Sun Chun becomes inconsolable. Taking Kelsey's words literally, Sun then steals 100 hamsters in an effort to ease her misery...

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP as they explore the wilderness of the creek together. The Stump Kids discover an inflatable slide in the middle of the Creek, and when the 10 Speeds commend Craig for finding it, he turns it into a mini attraction for the other kids. However, when the ride becomes stale, Craig transforms a section of the Creek into an amusement park called Craig World and ignores his friends and an air leak on the slide...

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Mom has forced Dad to install a password on the computer. The pop-up clue advises them that the password is the name of Dad's favorite child. After trying "Gumball" and "Darwin" unsuccessfully, they discover the answer is, in fact, "Anais". They are determined to become Dad's favourites by any means necessary, even if it means undermining each other, plotting against Anais or driving a wedge between mom and dad.

programme.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
programme.desc: A rival coffee shop moves into town.

programme.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
programme.desc: Mordecai and Rigby have to unload a lot of boba.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Each member of the family thinks their demographic has it the toughest. Gumball and Darwin think guys have it the worst. Mom thinks women do. Anais thinks kids do. programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are surprised to discover that their past actions have consequences. / Whilst Gumball and Darwin make fun of Mum and Dad for being old their voices start to break. / Sarah the new kid in school is Gumball and Darwin's number one slightly obsessive fan. / The new coach at Elmore High stands up to Jamie. / The secret behind Anton's immortality. / The kids finally get the puppy they always wanted except it's a turtle. / When Mum reveals that Gumball's real name is Zach Gumball adopts a cheesy annoying persona to match the name. / Nothing much is happening for Gumball and Darwin and the background characters in Elmore seize their moment.

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka
programme.desc: 10 Days is a Travelxp show about discovering unexplored places and their cuisine and interacting with the locals. It is time to go on a wonderful journey to Sri Lanka, uncover its never-ending enigma and experience the best of what this exotic country has to offer. Enjoy the show and add a new place to your list of new places to visit. Sri Lanka may be a small island in the Indian Ocean but there are so many things to see there: enormous tea plantations, breath-taking mountain railway, fantastic golden sandy beaches, amazing wild nature, colonial architecture from the days when the Portuguese, Dutch and English ruled.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: For many years passion for travelling has been bringing people to unexplored continents, countries and places to look into culture, history, food, nature and people. This kind of passion if the key point of Backpack, a travel show that opens new spots all over the world by a show host travelling solo with a backpack. So make yourself comfortable and enjoy visiting Serbia, Spain, Israel, India, Egypt and many more. Take a look at the historical past and modern life, find out about traditions, get to know tourism hotspots and treasures of nature, plan your future vacations with the help of show hosts' recommendations.

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Great World Hotels takes you on a journey to the some of the world's most luxurious hotels and resorts. We visit everything from your own personal lagoon island huts, the size of mansions, to the largest, most decadent penthouse in New York City. Live life like the stars as we explore every corner of the world from the comfort of your sofa. Season one alone takes us from Dubai to Mauritius to the Maldives. Whether you're an avid traveller or have never left the country, this journey is suitable for everyone. This is your journey. This is our journey.

programme.title: Xplore Egypt
programme.desc: Situated in the Mediterranean Sea, Egypt is home to one of the earliest civilizations in the world. From Cairo to Alexandria, and passing through Aswan and Luxor, this documentary allows you to discover some of the most beautiful cities in Egypt and reveal all their ancient secrets while highlighting all the leisure activities available now. With a rich culture, as well as vast landscapes, explore the tomb of the famous pharaoh Tutankhamun or walk alongside the Pharos Lighthouse.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Rebekka (Merle Palmiste) hakkab end Udumuna talus sisse sättima. Taluperemees (Ago Anderson) on tema võludest rabatud ja teeb arglikke lähenemiskatseid. Urmase (Sepo Seeman) ja Riina (Hilje Murel) jaoks on aga Rebekka kohaleilmumine otsekui halb unenägu. Taluelu teeb veel segasemaks seal suvitav luuletaja (Henrik Normann). Keegi aga ei tea, mis plaanid on talu ja selle elanikega Viksil (Andrus Vaarik).

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Freya ärkab laiba kõrval võõras korteris. Ta mõistab, et on vahepeal Astaks muutunud ja joomistsüklis olnud. Kui hiljem selgub, et kinnisest hullumajast on vabastatud mõrvar ja psühhopaat Margus Uniloo, on Freyal selge, kes ta süüdi lavastas.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Laura hakkab kahtlustama, et Chrisil on armuke, samas kui ta ise peab Kristina plaani järgi Tristaniga kohtuma, et Elina lõplikult armukadedusest hulluks ajada. Kristina pingutab aga mänguga üle ja Laura peab kodus Chrisile tõsiselt aru andma. Laura ja Chris vestlevad ausalt, aga kumbki ei ole lõpuni aus. Miša kardab, et on hulluks läinud. Teo kõrvalnähud süvenevad ja mees on juba päris eluohtlikus seisus. Laurat tabab aga suur šokk, kui ta avastab, kes võib olla Chrisi armuke!

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein ja Relika saavad ohtliku väljakutse eramajja, millesse on tunginud kentsakas röövel. Rein peab jaoskonnas salaja oma kodust pesu pesema, kuna ta pole ikka veel pesumasinat muretseda jõudnud. Ta üritab jaoskonnas rääkida kummalisest vihjest, mis võib olla seotud Kulbi tänava inimsöömisjuhtumiga, kuid satub naerualuseks. Väljakutsetel kohtutakse segaduses vanamammiga ja hullunud IT-mehega. Lisaks tuleb veenda ümber masenduses pintsaklipslane, kes tahab pilvelõhkuja katuselt alla hüpata. Reinule tuleb külla naise edukas vend Kuuno, kes palub Reinult kahtlast teenet. Rein saab kinnitust, et tema naine võib teda petta ja Relika ema paneb Relika pimekohtingul piinlikku olukorda. Vanemkomissar Kitzberg jääb mõneks ajaks vigastuse tõttu töölt eemale ja Reinu vihavaenlasest endine partner Urmas saab ajutiselt jaoskonna juhiks.

programme.title: Tulsa kuningas

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Tüdrukud lahendavad jubedat segapudru, mis Chrisi armukeseteemaga tekkis. Laura on Tristani ära võrgutanud ja peab ta nüüd julmalt maha jätma, et siis Kristina saaks ta sujuvalt üle võtta, aga Tristan pakub Laurale kihlasõrmust ja Laura lööb järsku kõhklema. Misha leiab ootamatult kadunud laiba üles ja satub kahtlasse olukorda. Maria saab Teo viljakusravist teada ja mees satub nüüd kõrvalnähtudega haiglasse. Marial on aga tekkinud usaldus ulaka õpilase isaga.

programme.title: Kullakesed
programme.desc: Dorothy, Blanche, Rose ja Sophia on neli eakat vanadaami. Nende kõigi suurimaks ühiseks jooneks on nende abikaasad - kõik on kas surnud või lahutand. Neli vanamemme otsustavad kokku kolida, et vanaduspõlve hõlpsamaks ning huvitavamaks teha.Kuid samas pole mitte ühelgi neist kadunud ammune janu meeste järgi. Igaüks üritab endale pidevalt kaaslast leida ning vahest ka teiselt üle trumbata.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein peab ootamatult oma kooliõpetajast ema juurde väljakutsele sõitma, koolis ootab teda aga kohtumine üllatava "kurikaelaga". Relika leiab oma isa üles ja ootab nüüd elu kõige tähtsamat pimekohtingut oma lihase isaga. Tallinnasse on tulemas kõrge väliskülaline ja jaoskond valmistub ministeeriumi näpunäidete toel tähtsaks sündmuseks. Rein jälitab oma naist, et hinge närivates kahtlustustes lõpuks selgusele jõuda ja põhjustab oma naise aeroobikatrennis suure segaduse. Reinu kodune elu muutub nüüd veelgi keerulisemaks ja ta peab otsima varjupaika oma ema juures. Ülemus paraneb ja tuleb jaoskonda tagasi, haiglas olek on pannud teda aga oma elule uue pilguga vaatama. Kulbi tänava inimsöömisjuhtum on endiselt lahenduseta ja kardetakse, et maniakk võib uuesti rünnata.

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Teises osas algab tõeline kassi-hiire mäng. Ometi ei sunni ka see Margus Unilood oma korterist lahkuma, et politsei saaks teda uinutipüssi abil uimastada. Ometi õnnestub Margusel taas kõiki üle kavaldada ja öösel Kättemaksukontorisse ilmuda, sooviga kõiki õhku lasta.

programme.title: Beverly Hills, 90210
programme.desc: Brandon otsustab Emilyle külla minna. John Sears üritab 15-aastast tüdrukut ära kasutada. Dylan keeldub Kelly tänupüha kutsest. Andrea kõhkleb Dani vanemate kodus peetava tänupühade peol osalemises.

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.title: Pöörased

programme.title: Rannavalve
programme.desc: Ühes Los Angelese rannas tegutseb vetelpäästjate rühm, mida juhib Mitch Buchannon. Nad päästavad elusid, maadlevad eraeluliste muredega, võitlevad kuritegevuse vastu ja löövad kaasa uskumatutes seiklustes.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Riina ja Urmas (Hilje Murel ja Sepo Seeman) saavad ülesandeks elavdada küla kultuurielu. Et kohapeal on võtta poeet (Henrik Normann), siis hakatakse korraldama luuleõhtut. Samal ajal üritab taluperemees (Ago Anderson) võita kauni Rebekka (Merle Palmiste) südant. See aga pole lihtne ülesanne, eriti kui üsna sõna otseses mõttes hakkab Jürkale kaikaid kodarasse loopima õel külakonstaabel (Aarne Soro). Viks (Andrus Vaarik) üritab endiselt Rebekka abil oma kinnisvaraäri käima lükata.

programme.title: Kired
programme.desc: Sarja peategelasteks on kaks abielupaari, kelle suhted muudab keeruliseks ühe paari naise ja teise paari mehe vahel puhkenud kirg. 1998. aastal TV3 eetris jooksma hakanud seriaali stsenaariumi autorid olid Aita Kivi, Juhan Habicht ja Stella K. Wadowsky, toimetaja Tiina Lokk, näitejuht Rein Oja, režissöörid Toomas Kirss ja Kalev Lepik. Peaosadesmängisid Merle Palmiste, Marika Vernik, Ita Ever, Märt Visnapuu ja Ivo Uukkivi. Produtsent oli Toomas Kirss.

Eesti publiku silme alt kadus Tõnuri vaikselt nagu tolm. Islandlastele jäi omakorda tundmatuks ja parasjagu arusaamatuks tema eelnev elu Eestis. Kes ta oli, kuidas ja miks ta sinna sattus? programme.title: Aja jälg kivis: Pariisi kunstikohvikud
programme.desc: Pariisi kuulsatel kohvikutel on piisavalt aega olnud, et kujuneda stiilseteks, luksuslikeks ja elegantseteks paikadeks. Maailma vanimaks pidevalt tegutsevaks kohvikuks peetud "Le Procope" on varsti juba ligi 330 aastat oma kohal seisnud. Samas on teada, et selles ilu, kunsti ja kuulsusrikast ajalugu tulvil linnas elanud eesti kunstnikud on eelmise sajandi alguses tekkinud uue kunstikeskuse Montparnasse'i kohvikukultuuri välja kujunemisele omal kombel kaasa aidanud ning sealtkandi kohvikuelu liikuma lükanud, nagu väidab Friedebert Tuglas. "Aja jälg kivis" kolib korraks raadiost teleekraanile ja viib vaataja Pariisi paljunäinud kunstikohvikutesse, mis jälgib uute kunstivoolude ja kirjandusteoste, filosoofiate ning teooriate sündi ja kus elavad muusad, innustus ning inspiratsioon. Režissöör Helen Valkna, produtsent Andres Arro, autor Helgi Erilaid.

programme.desc: Helgi Erilaiu legendaarse raadiosarja "Aja jälg kivis" televersioon jutustab loo meie raadiomajadest - nende värvikast saamisloost, neist kui oma aja arhitektuuripärlitest. Seda omalaadset rännakut läbi ehituskunsti ajaloo kaunistavad Erilaiu isiklikud mälestused tema enam kui poolsajandit kestnud raadioelust - mälestused kolleegidest, tehtud saadetest ja siin aset leidnud sündmustest. Ringhäälingu juubeli puhul pildikeelde tõlgitud saate režissöör on Helen Valkna, operaator Kristjan-Jaak Nuudi, kunstnik Inga Vares, produtsendid Silja Kala ja Andres Arro. programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Miami CSI meeskonda juhib pommiekspert Horatio Caine. Temaga koos teostavad uurimisi ballistik ja relvaekspert Calleigh Duquesne ja raamatukoi Tim Speedle, kes tunneb Miami tänavaid nagu oma taskuid. Lisaks aitavad neid DNA spetsialist Alexx Woods ja sukelduja Eric Delko. See viisik toob alati tõe kuritegude kohta päevavalgele.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Adrian Monk on üks San Francisco politseijaoskonna parimaid töötajaid, kuid pärast abikaasa traagilist surma on kõik muutunud: andekast detektiivist sai üleöö ettearvamatu ja impulsiivne inimene, kellel on ebanormaalsed hirmud ja kes ärritub väga kergesti. Sellest hoolimata püüab Monk oma tööd edasi teha, kuid sellel on ettearvamatud tagajärjed.

Oma naist leinav endine eriüksuslane Martin Riggs (Clayne Crawford) ja pärast infarkti tööle naasev Roger Murtaugh (Damon Wayans) moodustavad üdini vastandliku, aga ometi ideaalselt toimiva tandemi. Nende koostöö algus on okkaline, sest ohjeldamatu Riggsi pea-ees-tulle-sööstmise suhtumine põrkub vaoshoitud Murtaugh arusaamadega. Esimese ühise juhtumi lõppedes mõistavad aga mõlemad, et on lisaks uuele paarimehele leidnud endale ka parima sõbra.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: USA 2011 komöödia Lavastaja: Greg Mottola Osades: Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Seth Rogen, Jason Bateman, Sigourney Weaver, Bill Hader Kaks ulmefänni külastavad Ameerika UFO-piirkonda. Nad kohtuvad seal juhuslikult tulnukaga, kellega koos algab hullumeelne teekond, mis muudab nende maailma igaveseks. Tulnukas nimega Paul on viimased 60 aastat veetnud ülisalajases sõjaväebaasis. Kui ta saab aru, et ta on sattunud vangistusse, otsustab nutikas kosmoserändur põgeneda ning hüpata esimesele linnast välja suunduvale autole. Selleks osutub maalaste Graeme Willy ja Clive Gollingsi matkaauto. Graeme ja Clive mõtlevad välja kohmaka plaani, kuidas Paul tagasi oma emalaeva toimetada, kuid neid hakkavad taga ajama föderaalagendid ning kogemata röövitud neiu fanaatiline isa.

programme.title: Jackass: trikke hulludele!
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville ja tema maniakaalsed kaaslased teevad suurel ekraanil uusi trikke ja okseleajavaid paljastusi.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Karjääri lõpetavale rumalavõitu modellile tehakse ajupesu, et ta mõrvaks Malaisia peaministri.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: USA 2016 komöödia Lavastaja: Ben Stiller Osades:Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson, Penélope Cruz Blue Steel. Le Tigre. Magnum… need näoilmed suudavad lennult peatada surmava Hiina lendtähe ja nurjata kurja geeniuse maailmavallutamise plaanid. Maa peal on vaid üks meesmodell, kelle vapustav nägu suudab endas koondada sellist meeletut ilu ja väge. See on Derek Zoolander.Viimati nägime meesmodelle Derekit (Ben Stiller) ja Hanselit (Owen Wilson) rõõmsalt askeldamas omaloodud organisatsioonis "Derek Zoolanderi Keskus Lastele, Kes Ei Oska Hästi Lugeda Ja Tahavad Õppida Ka Muid Asju Hästi Tegema" ning kurikael Mugatu (Will Ferrell) istus vangis. Nüüd aga tabab Dereki keskust koletu katastroof, mis sunnib mõlemad meeskaunitarid avalikkusest eemale tõmbuma ning viisteist vananemisvastast aastat hiljem leiame mehed maailma eri otstest vaikset erakuelu elamas. Kui kumbki saab kutse Roomas toimuvale ülemaailmse kaliibriga moesündmusele, ei suuda nad vastu panna kiusatusele naasta oma kunagise kuulsuse radadele. Igaveses Linnas kohtuvad Derek ja Hansel veidrate ekstsentrikutestest disaineritega, kellele kuulub uus moeimpeerium. Iludused taipavad, et moemaailm, mida nad kunagi nii hästi tundsid, on tundmatuseni muutunud, kui nad paisatakse ilma igasuguse tseremooniata põmaki tagasi rambivalgusesse. Püüdes leida oma loogilist kohta selles tundmatus blogerite, vlogerite ja moevastaste moes, värvatakse duo peatama kurikavalat vandenõud, mis hävitaks igaveseks moemaailma lootuse taastada oma endine hiilgus. Ainult Derek ja Hansel suudaksid PÄÄSTA MOE.

programme.title: Suhete mänguväljak
programme.desc: Jalgpallurist südametemurdja satub saatuse tahtel laste jalgpallimeeskonna treeneriks. Sellest hetkest muutub jalgpalliplats tema hoolealuste ja nende veetlevate emade suhete mänguväljakuks.

programme.title: Napoleon Dynamite
programme.desc: Ükskõikne ja kõigist võõrandunud teismeline otsustab aidata uuel sõbral saada klassivanemaks. Samal ajal jagab sõber maid koju jäänud veidrikest pereliikmetega.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Autasustatud ja uljas sõjalendur pöördub tagasi Hawaiile, kohta, kus tema suurimad saavutused on aset leidnud. Seal kohtub ta oma endise armsamaga ning samal ajal armub juhuslikult oma järelvalvajasse. Lavastaja: Cameron CroweOsades: Bradley Cooper, Rachel McAdams, Emma Stone.

programme.title: Koonuspead
programme.desc: Tulnukapaar ja nende tütar teevad Maal hädamaandumise ja üritavad sulanduda äärelinna ühiskonda.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee ja suur pauk
programme.desc: Kogupere-komöödia teine osa! Ühel päeval jõuab Nanny McPhee (Emma Thompson) farmi, mida peab noor meeleheitel ema Isabel Green, kelle abikaasa on parasjagu rindel. Isabeli lastel on aga käimas "sõda" linnast saabunud ärahellitatud sugulaste vastu, kes suhtuvad kõigisse ja kõigesse piiritu ülbusega. Kasutades oma lendavat mootorratast, ellu ärkavat kivikuju, puu otsa ronivat põrsakest, pisikest elevandipoega ja palju muud, annab Nanny McPhee võlukunsti kasutades neile lastele viis väärtuslikku õppetundi, mida nad iial ei unusta.

programme.title: Kondimurdjad
programme.desc: Komöödia vangidest, kes teevad jalgpallimeeskonna, et valvuritega jõudu katsuda.

programme.title: Mu kallis nõiamoor
programme.desc: Jack Wyatt (Will Farrell) üritab saada sureliku peaosalise Darrini rolli samanimelise eduka 1960. aastate teleseriaali "Nõiutud" põhjal vändatavas filmis, mis võiks Jacki karjäärile uue hoo sisse anda, aga puudu on vaid üks oluline element - täiuslik Samantha, sarja teine peategelane. Kui Jack tutvub Isabeli (Nicole Kidman), heasüdamliku naisega, kes tahab vaid täiesti tavapärast elu elada, on Jack temast koheselt sisse võetud ja samas ka sügavalt veendunud, et Isabel peaks olema tema partner nii filmis kui ka elus. Paraku pole tal aimugi, et Isabel on päriselt nõid ja õige ruttu keerab nende tutvumine mõlema elu pea peale. Filmis teevad kaasa ka Shirley MacLaine ja Michael Caine. Tegu on uusversiooniga klassikalisest komöödiasarjast, mis käsitles armulugu erinevatest maailmadest pärit inimeste vahel ja jõudis tõdemuseni, et armastus võidab kõik.

programme.title: Bridget Jonesi beebi
programme.desc: Renée Zellweger naaseb, et jätkata teekonda läbi armastuse, elu ja naeru. Bridget on rase, ent ei tea, kumb kahest mehest on isa. Teistes peaosades on Colin Firth ja Patrick Dempsey. Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) on saamas neljakümne kolme aastaseks ja ta ema Pamela (Gemmaa Jones) ütleb talle, et kui ta plaanib lapsi saada, siis on selleks üsna viimane aeg. Ta läheb lennuõnnetusel hukkunud sõbra matusele, kus kohtub oma endise kallima Mark Darcyga (Colin Firth), kes on seal koos oma abikaasa Camillaga (Agni Scott). Pärast matusetseremooniat jätkab ta tööd oma telesaatejuhist sõbra Miranda (Sarah Solemani) produtsendina. Miranda tahab tähistada Bridgeti hiljutist sünnipäeva, ent too keeldub, et tähistada seda koos teiste sõpradega. Ent ta avastab end hüljatuna, kuna ta sõbrad on kõik oma lastega hõivatud. Pettununa võtab ta Miranda pakkumise vastu ning nad siirduvad koos muusikafestivalile. Üsna peatselt komistab Bridget näoli mudasse ning teda abistab nägus võõras mees. Festivali käigus satub ta juhuslikult joobnult valesse telki, kust leiab üllatuseks sama mehe, kes teda abistas. Nad seksivad. Järgmisel hommikul Bridget põgeneb märkamatult. Seejärel läheb ta ristsetele, kus on ise ristiemaks ja Mark on ristiisaks. Mark pihib talle, et nad lahutavad Camillaga oma abielu. Seejärel nad seksivad. Bridgetile meenub, et Mark pidas alati oma tööd nende suhtest tähtsamaks, ning ta põgeneb hommikul enne mehe ärkamist. Bridget märkab, et ta on hakanud kaalus juurde võtma, ja ta sõber Shazzer (Sally Phillips) veenab teda rasedustesti tegema. Test osutub positiivseks. Telesaate tegemise käigus märkab ta meest, kellega kohtus festivalil, ning saab oma üllatuseks teada, et see on kohtinguäpi loonud miljonär Jack Qwant (Patrick Dempsey). Saate filmimise pausi ausi ajal teatab Bridget Jackile oma rasedusest. Hoolimata algsest jahmatusest otsustab Jack teda toetada. Veidi hiljem teatab ta rasedusest ka Markile, kes satub isaks saamise mõttest elevusse. Bridget kutsub Jacki tööalasele üritusele ning on ehmunud, kui sinna ilmub ka Mark. Kaks meest saavad suurepäraselt läbi ning nad lähevad koos Bridgetiga õhtusöögile. Seal paljastatakse neile, et nad mõlemad võivad olla lapse isaks. Jack võtab selle uudise rahulikult vastu, ent Mark lahkub. Kuude möödudes lepib Mark lõpuks taas Bridgetiga ära. Tööalase eksimuse tõttu lahkub Bridget töölt, et vallandamist ennetada. Töötuna tunneb ta end nüüd hüljatult vihma kätte jäetuna. Mark saabub ja ütleb talle, et nad lahutasid naisega oma abielu. Nad on teineteist suudlemas, kui Bridgetil veed ära tulevad. Nad tõttavad haiglasse, ent neid takistavad liiklusummikud ja teetööd. Mark üritab meeleheitlikult naist kanda, ent vajub kokku. Jack saabub just õigel hetkel ning neil õnnestub Bridget sünnitusmajja toimetada. Seal sünnitab ta poja. Mark ja Jack otsivad lepitust, kui dr Rawlings (Emma Thompson) palub neil DNA testi teha. Aasta hiljem abiellub Bridget oma poja Williami isa Mark Darcyga. Koos pulmatseremooniale siirdudes tundub Bridgetile, et ta elu on täiuslik.

Kui kolm naabruskonna last Flo, Basim ja Kenza avastavad Pieteri talendi ja motivatsiooni, ühinevad nad ootamatuks superkangelaste tiimiks nimega tiim Hoodie. Neid ühendab üks eesmärk - vabastada naabruskond ülekohtust.
